ordered_training_hypotheses.hypothesis: The current latent velocity loss weights errors differently from their consequences in decoded geometry.
ordered_training_hypotheses.diagnosis: With a frozen decoder and fixed decoder noise, measure reconstruction, equal-RMS latent perturbations, and paths from predicted to target latents on an explicit length/continuity-stratified subset. Check latent stability under rigid rotations and small coordinate perturbations where the encoder pipeline is available. These tests select a loss experiment; they do not prove a ceiling.
ordered_training_hypotheses.comparison: Untouched checkpoint versus matched latent-only continued training versus a specifically revised geometry objective: conditional late-time endpoint supervision against stored reference coordinates, reproducible decoder noise, a nonsaturating robust distance term, and training-gradient-calibrated weighting. Two training arms start from identical weights and use the same proteins, ordering, latent noise, optimizer and update count for each paired seed.
ordered_training_hypotheses.geometry_loss: Begin with robust residue-distance errors from decoded endpoint estimates; include an orientation-sensitive local term and physical-geometry checks where residue correspondence is known. Distance-only supervision cannot distinguish mirror structures. Backpropagate through the frozen decoder; keep the latent loss to limit off-distribution drift.
ordered_training_hypotheses.controls: First establish finite gradients through the actual decoder and calibrate geometry gradient magnitude on training records only. Supervise conditional late-time endpoint estimates; assess actual full sampling because a one-step endpoint surrogate can improve without improving sampled structures. Geometry-specific randomness uses a separate stream so both arms retain identical flow-training draws.
ordered_training_hypotheses.gate: First measure gradients of the legacy and revised terms across denoising time and condition-drop states on training proteins. A revised term must have finite useful gradients and improve actual full-sampling development structures in a bounded pilot; latent loss or endpoint reconstruction alone is insufficient. If it fails, stop this branch rather than rescale it.
ordered_training_hypotheses.why_revisit: The prior negative auxiliary-loss experiment is acknowledged. Conditional late-time gating and noise/gradient controls are testable changes; their benefit is unknown.

ordered_training_hypotheses.hypothesis: Cached intermediate ESMC representations expose geometry more usefully than the last layer.
ordered_training_hypotheses.comparison: Audit the negative earlier-layer replacement result first. Validate matched sequence/coordinate identities and train/validation cluster separation in the existing final-layer and layer-80 caches. Use matched small distance/contact probes to ask whether layer 80 contributes complementary information. Only if it does, test an initially zero residual contribution from intermediate features while preserving final-layer conditioning, with the same folding head and unchanged loss.
ordered_training_hypotheses.gate: Reopen only if other diagnostics provide a specific new reason. Do not rerun earlier-layer sweeps or build new intermediate-layer caches.
ordered_training_hypotheses.status: deferred by user on 2026-09-30; earlier-layer probes already negative

ordered_training_hypotheses.hypothesis: Coverage and weighting of reliable long-chain and multi-domain training examples limit generalization.
ordered_training_hypotheses.comparison: Audit residue maps, chain breaks and structure confidence first. Then change only training sampling or weighting, balancing length and sequence clusters, while retaining the same head and objective.
ordered_training_hypotheses.gate: Improvement within prespecified length and continuity strata without hiding failures or reducing reported coverage.

ordered_training_hypotheses.hypothesis: A faster point or few-step predictor can distil an improved conditional teacher.
ordered_training_hypotheses.comparison: Use teacher-derived targets from training sequences only; evaluate one/four-step students at matched end-to-end cost after accuracy improves.
ordered_training_hypotheses.gate: Defer until a better teacher exists; no oracle sample selection.

predeclared_promotion_rule.accuracy_track: Paired mean fixed-correspondence TM gain at least 0.01 over the relevant matched control, sequence-cluster bootstrap lower bound above zero, reproducible across three training seeds, CA-lDDT delta lower confidence bound at least -0.005, geometry-outlier fraction delta upper confidence bound at most 0.001, and complete coverage. Confirm on the locked final test after choosing the recipe.
predeclared_promotion_rule.speed_track: at least 2x measured end-to-end speed, paired TM noninferiority lower bound above -0.005, predeclared CI procedure
predeclared_promotion_rule.note: Practical target, not an achieved accuracy gain. Cluster labels, a separate final test, training-loop implementation and backward profiling remain outstanding.

completed_reference.note: Validated inference precision does not establish safe or efficient backward precision.

data_contract.development: Existing 626 proteins remain reused development data. Freeze evaluation at 25 steps, guidance 2 and three paired inference samples per target.
data_contract.final_test: The original pre-training manifest lock could not be satisfied: blind September screening produced only three eligible targets. On 2026-09-30 freeze the broader Jan–Sep selection protocol and exclusion corpus before training; allow score-blind CPU curation during the development pilot. Final manifest and independent confirmation remain required before accuracy promotion.
data_contract.missing_maps: Do not guess adjacency through missing residues. Use verified continuous training records or explicit residue maps for geometry supervision; retain and separately report all development strata.
data_contract.uncertainty: Sequence-cluster bootstrap where cluster labels have been constructed; prediction samples are repeated measurements, not independent proteins. Training seeds are independent replications.

diagnostic.purpose: Audit gradients of the previously failed structural objective versus a conditional late-time alternative; test current-checkpoint decoder sensitivity with fixed noise. Bounded to 30 minutes of GPU allocation.

training_profile.purpose: Measure backward memory, examples/second and hardware counters for both objectives. Choose batch size and a fixed update budget that both arms can finish.

main_pilot.layout: Two objectives times three paired training seeds; six independent single-GPU jobs, no distributed training.
main_pilot.reference: Retain the untouched checkpoint to distinguish continued-training gain from the contribution of the new loss.
main_pilot.note: Small, fully residue-mapped training pilot; no general scaling inference. Two objectives times three paired training seeds. Auxiliary parameter gradient is capped at 10% of the flow gradient.

resource_rules.measurement: Report SM active, instruction issue, tensor activity, padding, actual proteins/second and peak memory; SM activity is not percent of peak FLOPs.
resource_rules.precision: Profile and validate training precision independently of inference precision.
resource_rules.followup: Register explicit IDs and an automatic analysis action before handing off; follow runs through completion and analysis.

accuracy_experiment_stages.budget_note: These are proposed maximum allocations, not measured runtime estimates or scheduled jobs.

prior_negative_evidence.reported_findings: The original report records negative results for structural lDDT auxiliary loss and replacing final-layer conditioning with the layer at 80 percent depth. Those are legacy-protocol results, not recomputed under the current scoring protocol.
prior_negative_evidence.structural_loss_details: Gate 19 chooses a random subset across all sampled times and condition-drop states; compares separately decoded endpoint and true latent with separate decoder-noise draws; applies a sigmoid local-distance score and a fixed auxiliary weight. Its source does not gate the structural loss to conditioned late-time examples.
prior_negative_evidence.interpretation: These are concrete differences to test, not established explanations for the negative result. Do not rerun the unchanged loss or blindly replace the final ESM layer.
prior_negative_evidence.existing_sensitivity_test: gate6_decoder_tolerance.py already tests isotropic perturbations and interpolation for an older ESM-2 point head. Extend the evidence to current flow checkpoints, fixed decoder noise, exact coverage and fixed-correspondence metrics rather than presenting sensitivity analysis as new.
